samples.summary: The share-link revalidation rewrite has no test at all
samples.evidence: `SharedDocumentByToken` was rewritten from a one-shot `useEffect` fetch into a `useQuery` with `refetchInterval: SHARE_LINK_REVALIDATE_MS`, `refetchOnWindowFocus`, `staleTime: 0`, `retry: 1`, plus a new combined `!token || error || !resolved` failure branch and a changed loading gate (`token && isLoading`). This is the mechanism the whole read-only-remount story in this PR depends on (every other comment points at `SHARE_LINK_REVALIDATE_MS` as the reason `readOnly` can change mid-session), and it decides when a revoked/downgraded link stops granting authority. No test exercises it: `packages/frontend/src/app/shared/__tests__/` contains only `shared-blob-routing.test.ts`, and a repo-wide grep for `resolveShareLink`/`SHARE_LINK_REVALIDATE` finds no test file. A regression (interval dropped, `enabled` wrong, error branch inverted, or a component that renders without a QueryClientProvider) would ship silently and either evict working sessions or keep revoked ones writable.

samples.summary: docs-view's readOnly remount + new store.dispose() cleanup is untested, unlike the notes/slides twins
samples.evidence: The diff adds `readOnly` to the docs editor effect deps and a new `store.dispose()` in its cleanup. The identical change in `notes-view.tsx` and `slides-view.tsx` each got a dedicated test (`notes-view-readonly.test.tsx`, `slides-view-readonly.test.tsx`), but nothing covers docs — no `docs-view` test file exists anywhere in packages/frontend (grep for `docs-view` returns only source files). Docs is the package the rest of this PR is about, and it is the only one of the three whose cleanup also has to release the Yorkie subscription; if the dep or the dispose is dropped, a downgraded share visitor keeps a fully writable docs editor and/or a stale store keeps driving a disposed editor, with no failing test.

samples.summary: The new requestLayoutRefresh seam (layout-without-paint, dirtyBlockIds restore) has no test
samples.evidence: `textEditor.requestLayoutRefresh` is newly wired in editor.ts and is what keeps `getLayout()` fresh while an undo unit holds the paint — the comment says the rest of a unit reads `blockParentMap` (the paste path branches on it) and wrap affinity, and that restoring `dirtyBlockIds` is what stops the deferred paint from re-measuring the whole document on every batched keystroke. Neither property is pinned: grep for `requestLayoutRefresh` across packages/docs finds only src files, `test/view/incremental-layout.test.ts` tests `computeLayout` directly (cache/dirty-set semantics, not this seam), and the only new render-related assertion in the PR (`ctxCalls.save === 1` in editor-undo-selection.test.ts) counts paints, not layout freshness. If the refresh is dropped or the dirty-set restore is wrong, a paste or Enter inside a table cell within a unit reads a stale parent map (mis-placed content) or every batched edit silently degrades to a full relayout — both invisible to the suite.

samples.summary: YorkieDocStore.dispose() is new public API with no test
samples.evidence: `dispose()` unsubscribes `doc.subscribe` and clears `onRemoteChange`, and its doc comment justifies it as preventing a replaced store from continuing to drive a disposed editor on `remote-change`. No test constructs a store, disposes it, applies a remote change and asserts `onRemoteChange` is not called (grep for `dispose()` under packages/frontend/tests hits only `PdfCommentStore` in tests/app/files/pdf-collab.test.ts, and yorkie-doc-store.test.ts never mentions dispose). Failure mode is contained (stale callbacks/leak) but would only surface as flaky behaviour after a permission-change remount.

samples.summary: willWrite() added to ~30 mutators; redo-drop only asserted through insertText/deleteText
samples.evidence: The diff moves redo invalidation from `snapshot()` into a `willWrite()` call placed at the top of every mutator (setDocument, replaceDocument, updateBlock, insert/deleteBlock*, setPageSetup, setDocStyles, style-definition ops, header/footer, all table ops, setBlockType, applyBlockStyle, insertImageInline, …). The new tests in test/store/memory.test.ts (lines 421-521) only ever write via `insertText`/`deleteText`, so a mutator that was missed (or one added later without `willWrite`) would leave a stale redo entry that Cmd+Shift+Z then applies over a diverged document — no test would catch it. A single table-driven case invoking each writer and asserting `canRedo()` becomes false would close this.

samples.summary: The new readOnly re-check on the resumed clipboard write is untested
samples.evidence: `pastePlainTextFromClipboard` now re-validates `this.disposed || this.pasting || this.readOnly` after the awaited clipboard read. The two new tests in packages/docs/test/view/large-paste-indicator.test.ts cover exactly the `pasting` and `disposed` halves; nothing covers the `readOnly` half (grep for `readOnly` under packages/docs/test hits only copy-integrity and editor-read-only, neither of which drives Cmd+Shift+V with a pending clipboard promise). Arguably hard to trigger since `readOnly` is fixed at `initialize()`, which is also why the guard could silently rot.

samples.summary: The notes/slides read-only remount tests mock the editor away, so they only prove the effect re-ran
samples.evidence: Both new tests replace `initialize`/`initializeEditor` with a stub that records the `readOnly` argument (`initCalls.push(readOnly)`) and assert `initCalls === [false, true]` plus a dispose/detach count. That pins the dependency array only — nothing verifies the rebuilt editor actually refuses writes, and the assertion would still pass if `readOnly` were forwarded but ignored downstream. Acceptable as a seam test, but it should not be read as coverage of the read-only enforcement the surrounding comments claim ('the visitor keeps a fully writable one').

finding.summary: The share-link revalidation rewrite has no test at all
finding.evidence: `SharedDocumentByToken` was rewritten from a one-shot `useEffect` fetch into a `useQuery` with `refetchInterval: SHARE_LINK_REVALIDATE_MS`, `refetchOnWindowFocus`, `staleTime: 0`, `retry: 1`, plus a new combined `!token || error || !resolved` failure branch and a changed loading gate (`token && isLoading`). No test exercises it: `packages/frontend/src/app/shared/__tests__/` contains only `shared-blob-routing.test.ts`, and a repo-wide grep for `resolveShareLink`/`SHARE_LINK_REVALIDATE` finds no test file. verdict.reason: The revalidation rewrite exists exactly as described: shared-document.tsx:88 defines SHARE_LINK_REVALIDATE_MS=60_000 and SharedDocumentByToken (lines 1107-1139) uses useQuery with refetchInterval, refetchOnWindowFocus, staleTime:0, retry:1, enabled:Boolean(token), a `token && isLoading` loader gate and a combined `!token || error || !resolved` failure branch. I searched well beyond the reviewer's paths: repo-wide grep for SHARE_LINK_REVALIDATE/resolveShareLink/SharedDocumentByToken/shared-document, the second frontend test root packages/frontend/tests/** (no app/shared dir), grep for refetchInterval/revalidat across all *.test.*/*.spec.* files, and a check for any e2e suite (none exists). The only tests that touch this module are shared-blob-routing.test.ts (imports the pure helper sharedBlobKind only), url.test.ts:166 (asserts resolveShareLink's URL encoding, not the component), and template-review-queue.test.tsx:30 which vi.mocks SharedDocumentByToken away. No test mounts the component or asserts the interval, enabled gate, loading gate, or error branch. Failure of this untested logic silently either keeps a revoked/downgraded share link authoritative or evicts a working session — user-visible and authority-affecting, so major under the missing-test rule.

verdict.reason: Verified the changed behavior exists in docs-view.tsx: `store.dispose()` in the effect cleanup (line 574) and `readOnly` in the effect deps (line 590, with an explicit comment that this is the only place a mid-session viewer downgrade is applied). No test anywhere exercises it. Repo-wide grep for DocsView/docs-view finds only source files plus prose comments; the sole importers are docs-detail.tsx:27 and shared-document.tsx:34, and no test renders either. I searched beyond the reviewer's paths: packages/frontend/tests/** (all docs tests target DocsFindBar, context menus, export button, etc.; docs-context-menu.test.tsx only mentions DocsView in a comment), grep for `dispose` in every packages/frontend/**/*.test.* (7 files, none docs), yorkie-doc-store.test.ts (zero `dispose` matches), harness scenarios (fixed readOnly, no assertions), and there is no e2e suite. By contrast notes-view-readonly.test.tsx:76-98 rerenders NotesView with readOnly flipped and asserts initCalls==[false,true] and disposeCalls==1, and slides-view-readonly.test.tsx exists and contains no docs reference, so it is not a shared parametrized test. Missing coverage over a change that silently weakens a write-permission guard and a subscription release = major under the test-adequacy rubric.
